## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Memory page allocation during initialization is now configurable with appropriate default values.

* **Chores**
  * Updated development tooling configuration to the latest schema version.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

This PR threads memory preallocation control into the public debugger API by adding an optional `preallocateMemoryPages` parameter to `resetJAM` (default 128) and `resetGenericWithMemory` (default 0). The parameters replace hardcoded values and pass through to underlying `decodeSpi` and `MemoryBuilder` calls. The PR also updates the Biome code formatter configuration schema reference from 2.4.10 to 2.4.15.

## Possibly related PRs

- [tomusdrw/anan-as#169](https://github.com/tomusdrw/anan-as/pull/169): Previous work on `decodeSpi` memory preallocation that this PR now exposes as a configurable parameter.
- [tomusdrw/anan-as#142](https://github.com/tomusdrw/anan-as/pull/142): Related memory allocation pipeline changes to `MemoryBuilder` heap growth and eager allocation thresholds.
